senses.gloss: m. (שָׁעַר) proportion, standard, definite quantity or size, limit.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 1:1">Peah I, 1</cite> <he>אלו … שאין להם ש׳</he> for the following things there is no definite proportion or quantity prescribed. Y. ib. 15ᵃ bot. <he>אין להם ש׳ לא למעלן וכ׳</he> they have no limits set either of a maximum or of a mininum.
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:7">Ḥall. I, 7</cite> <he>אם אין … כש׳</he> if either portion is not of the legal size (to require the separation of the priest’s share).
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 4:8">Ib. IV, 8</cite> <he>של אור יש לה ש׳ וכ׳</he> for that portion of Ḥallah which is to be burnt there is a legal quantity (a minimum) &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 4:8">Ib.</cite> <he>של אור אין לה ש׳ וכ׳</he> for that which is to be burnt there is no minimum prescribed, but there is one for that which is to be given to the priest.
Nidd. 26ᵃ ש׳ שופר the legal length of a shofar.
<cite ref="Niddah 26a:27">Ib.</cite> <he>חמשה שִׁיעוּרָן טפח</he> for five things the legal minimum size is a handbreadth.
<cite ref="Yoma 73b:15">Yoma 73ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>חצי ש׳</he> half (less than) the legal quantity; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>שׁיעוּרִים</he>, <he>שִׁיעוּרִין</he>, <cite ref="U00992"><he>שִׁע׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 80a:11">Ib. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>כל הש׳ כולן בכזית וכ׳</he> all legal standards (for eatables in ritual law) are the size of an olive, except &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 80a:11">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>ש׳ ועונשין הלכה וכ׳</he> standard measures and penalties are fixed by tradition, expl. <he>ש׳ של עונשין</he> the minima required for punishment.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:4">Sabb. VII, 4</cite> <he>מפני ששוו בשִׁיעוּרֵיהֶן</he> because they are alike as to legal standards.

<cite ref="Shabbat 80b:9">Ib. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>כל שִׁיעוּרֵי שבת</he> all legal minimum sizes for eatables carried abroad on the Sabbath; a. fr.—Ib. 35ᵇ <he>נתת דבריך לש׳</he> thy rule would vary according to circumstances, and would not be alike for all; <cite ref="Megillah 18b:2">Meg. 18ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:5:2">Y. B. Bath. V, end, 15ᵇ</cite> <he>לש׳</he> for regulating the market prices, v. <cite ref="U01679"><he>שַׁעַר</he> I</cite>.
